{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

**Purpose**: A living document to capture, organize, and track all new ideas.

## Table of Contents
1. Idea ID
2. Title
3. Description
4. Date Added
5. Owner
6. Status (New / In Review / Approved / Implemented / Archived)
7. Priority (1-5)
8. Notes

## How to Use
- Add a new entry at the bottom of the document.
- Update status and notes as the idea progresses.
- Archive ideas that are no longer relevant.

---

### Example Entry
| Idea ID | Title | Description | Date Added | Owner | Status | Priority | Notes |
|---------|-------|-------------|------------|-------|--------|----------|-------|
| 001 | Automate report generation | Create a script to auto-generate monthly sales reports | 2024-06-23 | Alice | New | 3 | Initial research needed |

---

Feel free to customize the template as needed.
", "file_name": "FreshIdeasTracker.txt"}
